description: CM-B31: the activity fields the v1 app (mobile-app) reads, per activity type. Paths are on the object v1 components receive: { id, type, nodeId, sequenceNumber, instruction, ...config } (mobile-app app/(app)/lesson/[nodeId].tsx:180-187); config keys are top level, and a literal config.x path is a nested `config` key inside config. Syntax: a.b keys, a[] every array element, length on arrays/strings. Rule and comparison: supabase/functions/_shared/core/domain/content-audit/v1-fields.ts. Run: tests/golden/README.md, section v1 field golden.

source.method: read of src/curriculum/activities (each registered component, its shared helpers and children), src/curriculum/engine, src/curriculum/utils/levelIntro.ts, src/hooks/useLevelIntro.ts and app/(app)/lesson/[nodeId].tsx; every cited line checked to mention the field or the helper that reads it

paths.note: Played as instruction audio, preloaded, cached by URL. In raw form (map warmActivityAssets, levelIntro) it is the top-level instruction.audio_url of the response, same path.
Camel-case fallback in getInstructionAudioUrl (preload/cleanup only; the playback path in ActivityWrapper reads only audio_url).

Envelope instruction is placed first, then ...config spread, so a config key named instruction overrides it. Only instruction.audio_url/audioUrl are read; text is dropped (renderActivity deletes it from Sentry context).
Envelope id; config spread comes after so a config.id would override it. Used as key, preload cache key, completion matching.
Envelope type selects component and registry meta; config.type would override it. levelIntro reads raw response type (same path).
Set by lesson screen from route param; only Sentry telemetry. A config.nodeId would override it.

Written into flattened object from envelope sequence_number; no engine read found. Raw sequence_number is read at src/curriculum/utils/levelIntro.ts:17 (envelope field, not config). Envelope sequence_number, flattened as sequenceNumber. Raw response field (not config), flattened as sequenceNumber. Level intro picks the lowest sequence_number activity of the first node.
interactive === false suppresses celebration for every type (getBehavior) and, for content_with_cards, makes it audio-gated. Also read via config.interactive (see next).
Literal nested config key fallback (registry.ts:77 checks it FIRST, ActivityRegistry:140 checks root first).
Overrides the registry default for the footer (activity.hideFooterUntilComplete ?? behavior).
Gates skipActivity; skipActivity is not wired to UI evidence in this scope (LessonEngine:296 handler calls it).
Literal nested key named config inside config. Preloader extractImageUrls does activity.config || activity, so if present all image reads move under config.*. Normally absent.

Default branch of extractImageUrls switch: applies to every type not listed in its own case (all types except multiple_choice_question, content_with_cards, show_letter_or_word, break_time_minigame, tap_letter_in_word, build_word_from_letters, add_pizza_toppings_with_letter). All URLs must be strings starting with 'http'. Preloader reads via config = activity.config || activity (root paths; a literal nested config key would redirect all these reads to config.*; raw ActivityData from map prefetch has real config so root paths there = config.*).
